decisionsTitle: A design-system page in the backoffice, and the redesign plan in the repository
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10, after reading the redesign plan the dispatcher had written in a private Claude document:** «that Claude design artifact should go somewhere in the app so we can all access it, and we need a design system page, similar to Flyward». Flyward is his other product; its design system is an in-app area with a rail and pages for the tokens (a tree with every value in both looks), the components, the icons, samples, guidelines, a status page and a theme builder.

**Decision.** For the club, at the club's size and under its standing instruction («fast, clean, easy to work on»; prefer nothing over a dependency), one backoffice page: «Sistemul de design» / "Design system" at `/admin/design`, read by whoever reads the club's content — the Redactor and up, `canReadContent`, asserted in the route's layout above the loading boundary (a 404 to a volunteer, BR-REQ-060-01) and again in the page. It is reached from «Setări» → «Aspect», where a card «Sistemul de design» carries one sentence and one button; the bar lights «Setări» on it, as it does on `/devs` (§520), and the guide's «Aspect» entry names it. It is a reference, not a bar section: the bar is the club's daily work.

The page **draws the look from the code, never from a copy**: every key of `COLOR`, `COLOR_DARK` and `SITE_TINT` as a swatch with its hex, the gradients as bars, the text/background pairs with their contrast ratio from the one helper (`tint-contrast.ts`), the theme's typography variants rendered as themselves with family, weight and size read from `theme.typography`, the self-hosted faces with «ș ț ă â î», the radius, shadows, breakpoints, spacing, `DENSITY` and the 44-pixel square, the public `ButtonLink` and the backoffice `GlyphButton`s in their variants, sizes and states, `RoutePills` built by `buildRoutePills` from fixture rows (the fifteen difficulty gauges, the three surfaces, the three costs, night, special, the weather pill, the partner mark), the calendar chip in each state, the filter chips, a sample `EventCard` and `SeriesCard`, the featured surface, a team card without a photograph, the house field, select, checkbox, alerts and fold, and every name of `glyphs.ts` and `action-icons.ts` at 24 pixels with the counts in the headings. A token or a glyph added to the code is on the page at the next render, and `tests/unit/design/design-page.test.ts` asserts every key and every name from the same constants.

The text/background pairs that lived as prose rows in `tests/unit/theme/brand.test.ts` are now `src/theme/brand-pairs.ts` — `TEXT_PAIRS`, `TEXT_PAIRS_DARK`, `HERO_PAIRS`, `ACCENT_PAIRS`, each named by its tokens — which the test imports back and pins by name, so the table the page draws and the pairs the test holds at AA are one list. The house rules of «Reguli» are a typed list too (`src/modules/design/rules.ts`): the sentence in the catalogues, the files and tests that hold it as code, because a backoffice string never names a repository path or a §-number (§511) while a design-system page exists to say where each rule lives.

**The redesign plan** is in the repository: `docs/REDESIGN.md`, the dispatcher's full text in English — the twelve decisions only the club can make, with the default each gets if nobody objects, what exists versus what is new, the visual system, the seven phases and their gates, the content the club provides, the open questions. The page's last section renders the decisions and the phases from a typed data module (`src/modules/design/redesign-plan.ts`: ids, a status per row — `default` / `decided` / `open` for a decision, `planned` / `building` / `released` for a phase — and message keys, the words in both catalogues), each row with a status chip; the dispatcher moves a status as the club answers and the work lands. Today every decision is `default` and every phase `planned`. The page says that the side-by-side of today's look and the new one comes with the facelift's phase 1; it is not in this change.

**Refused:** a design-system site of many pages with a rail, as Flyward has (the club's size: one page with a contents row); a Markdown renderer dependency for the plan (a typed data module and a repository document instead, and nothing new installed); a bar section for the page (a reference under «Aspect», not daily work); a copy of the tokens as data for the page (it drifts; the page imports what the site imports); fixture data that names a person or a real event (the repository is public: «Alergare de probă», «Membru A»).

The fixture rows, the sample weather and the sample member live in `src/modules/design/fixtures.ts`; the page reads no database and writes nothing, so there is nothing to audit. The e2e words sweep (`client-words.spec.ts`) walks `/ro/admin/design` with the other backoffice routes; the file-system walk of `test:e2e:dev` finds the route by itself.
changelogLine: - **«Sistemul de design» in the backoffice, and the redesign plan in the repository** — «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Sistemul de design» (`/admin/design`, the Redactor and up) draws the site's look from the code: every colour token with its hex and the asserted text/background pairs with their contrast ratio, the theme's type variants and self-hosted faces, the shapes, shadows and the 44-pixel rule, the public and backoffice buttons, every pill and glyph, sample cards and form blocks from made-up rows, and the house rules with where each lives; its last section is the redesign plan's twelve decisions and seven phases with a status each, whose full text is `docs/REDESIGN.md`. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given `/admin/design` («Sistemul de design»), when a staff member requests it, then it is served to whoever reads the club's content — the Redactor and up, `canReadContent` — and is a 404 to anyone else, asserted in the route's layout above the loading boundary and again in the page; the page reads no database and writes nothing (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `design/design-page.test.ts`.

Given «Setări» → «Aspect», when it renders, then it carries a card «Sistemul de design» with one sentence and one button, at least 44 pixels tall, to `/admin/design`, whose contents row is one anchor per section, each a 44-pixel target; the bar lights «Setări» on `/admin/design` as it does on `/devs` (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `design/design-page.test.ts`, `staff/pages-row.test.ts`; e2e `client-words.spec.ts`.

Given the text/background pairs the pages render, when the design-system page draws them with their contrast ratio, then the pairs are `src/theme/brand-pairs.ts` — one list, named by its tokens — which `theme/brand.test.ts` imports back, pins by name and holds at WCAG 2.1 AA with the one contrast helper of `appearance/domain/tint-contrast.ts`; a pair dropped from the list fails the test rather than leaving the page quietly (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `theme/brand.test.ts`, `design/design-page.test.ts`.
